class0901.description: A completed class on restaurant vocabulary, polite requests, and handling surprises on the menu.
materialDescriptions: Review the words from this class.

class0901.homework: Record a 60-second restaurant order and listen back once.
class0901.recap: You handled the ordering role-play without switching to English. Keep the polite request frames active and rehearse the wrong-order fix once before the next class.

class0902.description: A focused class on vowels, rhythm, and the sounds that make Spanish feel fast.
materialDescriptions: The sounds and drills from class.
class0902.teacherNote: Your rhythm is much better. Keep the shadowing routine for five minutes before each class.
class0902.homework: Shadow the same dialogue three times this week.
class0902.recap: Vowels are cleaner and the rhythm is steadier. The next step is keeping the same pace when you improvise instead of reading.
